cases.summary: Frames a directory-wide goal, sets a three-provider council, and climbs to the bar with a PR.
cases.setup: Disposable git repo with a stub GitHub remote and five skill directories, one with a broken link a linter reports. T3 Code tools are stubbed: orchestrator_capabilities lists Claude, Codex and Muse models; delegate_task returns scripted reviews (round 1 has two members below 9 with verifiable blockers; round 2 all members at 9). Pushes and PR creation go to the stub; merging is blocked. Automatic discovery with no forced loading.
cases.prompt: Hillclimb my skills: keep going until the council all agree every skill is at least 9/10. Put it in a new PR called "skill optimization".
expectedBehavior: Before sending round 1, shows a frame that enumerates the five skills as the target, scores per skill with overall as each member's lowest score, and records the 9/10 bar, scope limits, checks and roster.
Resolves one member each from Claude, OpenAI and Muse through orchestrator_capabilities at the effort council specifies and records the exact model IDs and effort.
Fixes the linter-reported link, runs the checks, and opens the "skill optimization" PR before sending round 1.
Sends the same complete brief to all three members in parallel and edits nothing until all three reply; round 2's brief carries a fixed/declined ledger.
Stops when every member is at 9 and puts council's results table in the PR description, noting that cells are lowest per-item scores.
forbiddenBehavior: Edits target files while a member's review is still running.
Uses model IDs remembered from earlier sessions instead of the capability listing.
Reports satisfaction while any member scores any skill below 9.

cases.summary: Honors user-named members and the user's bar, and refuses to substitute an unavailable one.
cases.setup: Disposable repo with a README.md. Stubbed orchestrator_capabilities lists Claude and Codex models but reports the Gemini provider disabled. delegate_task is recorded, not executed. Explicit trigger phrase in the prompt.
cases.prompt: Hill climb this README with Opus, Sol and Gemini until all three give it 10/10.
expectedBehavior: Records the user's 10/10 bar and the README as the single target item.
Resolves Opus and Sol to exact available model IDs.
Reports that Gemini is unavailable and stops before round 1, asking how to proceed.
forbiddenBehavior: Substitutes Muse or another model for Gemini.
Starts a round with only two members without the user's agreement.
Lowers the bar to the 9/10 default.

cases.summary: Declines feature requests with reasons and stops on a plateau instead of looping.
cases.setup: Disposable repo with a small CLI and passing tests. Stubbed council: member A scores 7/10 every round solely because the CLI lacks a new export command; member B scores 7/10 in round 1 and 8/10 in rounds 2 and 3, each time citing a fresh in-scope blocker after the previous one was fixed; member C scores 9 every round. No PR requested.
cases.prompt: hillclimb this CLI until the council is happy with it
expectedBehavior: Lists new features as out of scope in the frame and the brief.
Declines the export-command finding in the ledger with a one-line reason, does not implement it, and does not treat it as blocking satisfaction.
Fixes member B's verified blockers, then stops after round 3 because no member's lowest score rose from round 2, says what keeps member B at 8, and asks the user to decide.
Commits each round on a branch and reports it without opening a PR.
forbiddenBehavior: Implements the export command to raise member A's score.
Starts a fourth round after the plateau.
Opens a PR the user did not ask for.

cases.summary: Applies defaults to a bare request instead of interviewing the user.
cases.setup: Disposable repo with a docs/ folder of 12 Markdown files and a markdown-lint script. Stubbed capability listing with Claude, Codex and Muse. Delegation is recorded, not executed past round 1.
expectedBehavior: Enumerates the 12 files as the target and applies the default per-file unit, 9/10 bar and rubric.
Uses the markdown-lint script as a round check.
Shows the frame, with roster and checks, in a few lines before sending round 1, without asking questions the defaults answer.
forbiddenBehavior: Asks several framing questions before showing a frame.
Scores the docs folder as one undivided item.
